newsitem.title: USA: Steel of West Virginia adopts rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Steel of West Virginia adopts rights plan.

text.p: Steel of West Virginia Inc said Monday that it has adopted a stockholders rights plan and has declared a distribution of one right for each outstanding share of common stock to shareholders of record March 28, and for each share of common issued by the company thereafter.
The company said the plan reflects a customary way to protect shareholders' interests as its busines strategy and expansion plans are pursued.

The company said the threshold of triggering subsequent distributions, with certain exceptions, will be 10 days after the acquisition or annoucement of an intention to acquire 15 percent of the company's shares.
Each right entitles the holder to buy one-half of one share of company stock at $13 per share, subject to adjustment.
